escalation.note_requirement: Name the absent date of the qualifying face-to-face encounter in EVAL-PA90-01 and the lack of any alternate dated encounter record; request a signed dated correction or a qualifying dated record before transmission. A note signature date is not the encounter date.

rule_provenance: CMS DMEPOS Order and Face-to-Face Encounter Requirements, Face-to-Face Encounter section, modified 2026-07-31: https://www.cms.gov/data-research/monitoring-programs/medicare-fee-service-compliance-programs/medical-review-and-education/dmepos-order-requirements. Required PA List updated 2026-07-29, K0823 row: https://www.cms.gov/research-statistics-data-and-systems/monitoring-programs/medicare-ffs-compliance-programs/dmepos/downloads/dmepos_pa_required-prior-authorization-list.pdf. The office date-check and correction workflow are fictional administrative rules; clinical findings are signed practitioner inputs.
